answer: A workable design charges newcomers upfront and refunds on merit. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the pulse of free entry disappears, the comet of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the oasis case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm stops.
